Right-wing authoritarianism

1 Study and sample

The right-wing authoritarianism score (rwa) was measured in waves 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5. Scored N per wave: 500, 500, 500, 500, 500. No respondent is excluded, a provisional rule (decision log D22).

2 Items and coding

Items (guide reference: Beierlein, Asbrock, et al. (2014), Nießen et al. (2019)). Response scale: 1 = strongly disagree, 4 = neither, 7 = strongly agree. Non-answer codes observed: 0.
Item Wording Facet Waves Direction
rwa_1 We should take strong action against misfits and slackers in society. aggression 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
rwa_2 Troublemakers should be made to feel that they are not welcome in society. aggression 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
rwa_3 Rules in society should be enforced without pity. aggression 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
rwa_4 We need strong leaders so that we can live safely in society. submission 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
rwa_5 People should leave important decisions in society to their leaders. submission 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
rwa_6 We should be grateful for leaders telling us exactly what to do. submission 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
rwa_7 Traditions should definitely be carried on and kept alive. conventionalism 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
rwa_8 Well-established behavior should not be questioned. conventionalism 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
rwa_9 It’s always best to do things in the usual way. conventionalism 1, 2, 3, 4, 5

Score. rwa is the mean of its 9 items in the scored direction (higher = more right-wing authoritarianism), computed when at least 7 are valid. Scoring rules and names are provisional until the lead signs off (decision log D4, D21).

7 Adjusted model

OLS of right-wing authoritarianism on demographics and left-right self-placement, wave 1. Outcome and numeric predictors in SD units, so group terms are differences in outcome SDs. R² = 0.15. N = 453.
Term Beta [95% CI]
Female (vs male) 0.06 [-0.12, 0.23]
Age 0.05 [-0.04, 0.13]
Entrance qualification (vs none) -0.30 [-0.51, -0.09]
University degree (vs no entrance qualification) -0.42 [-0.64, -0.19]
Household income band 0.10 [0.01, 0.20]
East (vs West) 0.39 [0.19, 0.60]
Berlin (vs West) -0.32 [-0.68, 0.04]
Left-right self-placement (right = high) 0.26 [0.18, 0.35]

The model describes associations in this sample. Education groups are provisional (decision log D26), and “another gender” is excluded from the model as too small to estimate.

9 Measurement notes

  • The nine KSA-3 items were asked in all five waves with the same wording and scale, so every wave comparison uses the same item set.
  • The guide lists the items without facets, so I took the facet split from the KSA-3 publication (decision log D19).
  • An extra undocumented authoritarianism field was withheld from the extract.

10 Reproducing this report

Rebuild with Rscript run.R. Package versions are pinned in renv.lock, and every coding decision is in the decision log.

 

Aggregate results only. Study E is a pseudonymous, embargoed extract; no respondent records are published.
